docs.title: Chlorophyll Monitoring in Solina Reservoir
docs.text:
Welcome to our space tech project! Here, we leverage remote sensing and satellite imagery to monitor chlorophyll levels, ensuring sustainable water resource management.

This project is part of the Earth Observation course at AGH University. It focuses on analyzing Sentinel-2 satellite data to estimate chlorophyll-a concentration in Solina Reservoir.

docs.title: 🚀 Project Highlights
docs.text:
• Daily and high-res monitoring using Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-3.
  • Field validation with spectroradiometers.
  • Time-series analysis for seasonal trends.
  • Automated scripts for future water quality tracking.

📍 Dive into our Analysis or learn about the Methodology!

docs.title: 📊 Chlorophyll Analysis of Solina Reservoir
docs.text: In this section, we present the results of our monitoring project, based on Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, and field measurements.

docs.title: 🌍 Spatial Distribution of Chlorophyll-a
docs.text:
High-resolution maps have been generated to show spatial variability across the Solina Reservoir.

  • Sentinel-2 MSI captures fine-scale features (5-day revisit).
  • Sentinel-3 OLCI provides daily monitoring for detecting rapid changes.

docs.title: 📈 Temporal Trends and Seasonal Variations
docs.text:
Chlorophyll-a levels were monitored over multiple seasons to identify trends:

Season Chlorophyll-a Levels Observations Spring Low to Moderate Melting snow and moderate nutrient runoff. Summer High Peak of algal blooms due to warm temperatures and nutrient load. Fall Moderate Stabilization after summer blooms. Winter Low Cold temperatures, stable water conditions.

docs.title: 🛰️ Sentinel-2 vs Sentinel-3 vs Field Data
docs.text:
To ensure accuracy, satellite observations were compared with in situ field measurements.

Data Source Resolution Accuracy (R²) Sentinel-2 MSI 10–20 m 0.87 Sentinel-3 OLCI 300 m 0.81 In Situ (Spectroradiometer) Point-based Reference

✅ Sentinel-2 provides superior spatial detail. ✅ Sentinel-3 excels in frequent temporal coverage.

docs.title: 🧠 Key Insights
docs.text:
• Chlorophyll peaks strongly align with summer months.
  • Algal blooms were detected early using daily Sentinel-3 data.
  • Fusion of datasets improves both spatial and temporal resolution for monitoring.

docs.title: Data sources
docs.text:
• 🛰️ Sentinel-3 OLCI – Daily revisit time, ocean color-based chlorophyll detection.
  • 🛰️ Sentinel-2 MSI – 5-day revisit time, high-resolution water quality monitoring.
  • 🌍 Copernicus Water Quality Services – Reference chlorophyll datasets.
  • 📏 In situ spectroradiometer measurements – Ground truth validation.

docs.title: 🛠️ Methodology
docs.text:
Our workflow includes:

  1. Preprocessing Sentinel-3 OLCI imagery.
  2. Integrating Sentinel-2 MSI high-res images.
  3. Validating results with in situ spectroradiometer data.
  4. Time-series analysis for seasonal monitoring.

docs.title: Final Deliverables:
docs.text:
• Chlorophyll concentration maps and trends.
  • Automated processing script for Sentinel-based monitoring.
  • Report on water quality changes and potential eutrophication risks.

🚀 This project will contribute to sustainable water resource management by providing an advanced monitoring system for chlorophyll levels in Solina Reservoir.
